submission.justification: Crystal-K1 gives the best resolution (2.73% FWHM at 5 cm) but its intrinsic background (2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day, dominated by internal contamination) is four times the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day, so it is unsuitable for low-background operation. Crystal-K2 has the lowest background (0.10) but poor resolution (8.5%). Crystal-K3 is the best compliant option: background 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day (within budget) and 4.56% FWHM at 5 cm. Its resolution across thicknesses was 5.30% (2 cm), 4.84% (3 cm), 4.56% (5 cm), 4.94% (8 cm), 6.51% (10 cm), so 5 cm is the optimum tested. Ranking the requirements: low-background suitability is a hard constraint, so K1 is excluded despite its better resolution.
